policy.rule: The map only gains lines. An old identifier is never rewritten: already-published releases are immutable (ADR-132) and keep the IRIs they shipped with. Each entry records the base new releases mint that identifier family under — a NAME MAPPING, not an HTTP redirect; SIG does not claim the old IRIs dereference over HTTP to SIG infrastructure.
policy.residual_risk: sig-project.org and sig.example stay unregistered (defensive registration declined, B-6; RISK-R11-29, docs/risk_register.md). A third party may still register them; nothing inbound depends on them — every emission carries the owned base.
policy.how_to_append: Add one entry per newly-discovered or newly-retired identifier family: {family, old_base, new_base, match, first_seen, surfaces, note}. Never remove or reorder an entry; corrections append a superseding note field. `match: prefix` means the old identifier maps by swapping the base prefix and keeping the remainder verbatim.
